pos_signed_delegation_

# container length bytes recomputed, verify() MUST reject all of them. ---
neg_inverted_
neg_zero_
neg_unassigned_
neg_unknown_
neg_unknown_
neg_missing_
neg_wrong_
neg_foreign_
neg_corrupt_
